data: A városból kivezető utakat lezárták. Kijárási tilalom van érvényben. Holttestek hevernek a kihalt utcákon. A boltok üresek. Ahogy sok ház is, mert lakóik elmenekültek, amíg lehetett. Matthew itt maradt, hogy ápolja beteg édesanyját, aki valamilyen rejtélyes betegségben szenved. Egy nap váratlan dolog történik: Matthew rég elveszett apja, aki elhagyta a családot, felbukkan. El akarja vinni fiát a városból, amelynek napjai meg vannak számlálva. (The roads leading out of the city are closed. There is a curfew. Dead bodies litter the deserted streets. Shops are empty. So are many houses, because their inhabitants fled while they could. Matthew has stayed behind to care for his sick mother, who is suffering from some mysterious illness. One day, the unexpected happens: Matthew's long-lost father, who had left the family, turns up. He wants to get his son out of the town, whose days are numbered.)

The roads leading out of the city are closed. There is a curfew. Dead bodies litter the deserted streets. Shops are empty. So are many houses, because their inhabitants fled while they could. Matthew has stayed behind to care for his sick mother, who is suffering from some mysterious illness. One day, the unexpected happens: Matthew's long-lost father, who had left the family, turns up. He wants to get his son out of the town, whose days are numbered.
